job.command:
set nonomatch cp asymmetry/hist_entries.C . @ line_start = ${JOBINDEX} * {{NPERJOB}} + 1 @ line_end = ${line_start} + {{NPERJOB}} - 1 sed -n "${line_start},${line_end}p" {{RUNLIST}} > my_runs.list echo "JOBINDEX ${JOBINDEX}: runs ${line_start}-${line_end}"
foreach run ( `cat my_runs.list` ) rm -f part_*.root merged.root set parts = `find {{HISTDIR}} -maxdepth 1 -name "an_hists_${run}_*.root"` if ( $#parts < 2 ) then echo "run ${run}: $#parts file(s), nothing to merge" continue endif set ok = 1 set i = 0 foreach p ( ${parts} ) @ i = ${i} + 1 cp ${p} part_${i}.root if ( ! -s part_${i}.root ) set ok = 0 end if ( ${ok} == 0 ) then echo "ERROR run ${run}: copy failed, parts kept" continue endif tcsh -c 'module purge; module load root-5.34.38; hadd -f merged.root part_*.root' >&! hadd.log if ( $status != 0 || ! -s merged.root ) then echo "ERROR run ${run}: hadd failed, parts kept" tail -5 hadd.log continue endif setenv HE_PATTERN 'part_*.root' set nin = `tcsh -c 'module purge; module load root-5.34.38; root -l -b -q hist_entries.C' |& grep '^ENTRIES' | awk '{print $2}'` setenv HE_PATTERN merged.root set nout = `tcsh -c 'module purge; module load root-5.34.38; root -l -b -q hist_entries.C' |& grep '^ENTRIES' | awk '{print $2}'` if ( "${nin}" == "" || "${nin}" != "${nout}" ) then echo "ERROR run ${run}: entries ${nin} in parts, ${nout} merged; parts kept" continue endif cp merged.root {{HISTDIR}}/.an_hists_${run}_m.root.tmp if ( ! -s {{HISTDIR}}/.an_hists_${run}_m.root.tmp ) then echo "ERROR run ${run}: copy back failed, parts kept" rm -f {{HISTDIR}}/.an_hists_${run}_m.root.tmp continue endif # the old merged file (if any) is one of the parts: delete parts, then put the new one in place rm -f ${parts} mv {{HISTDIR}}/.an_hists_${run}_m.root.tmp {{HISTDIR}}/an_hists_${run}_m.root echo "run ${run}: merged $#parts files, ${nout} entries" end rm -f part_*.root merged.root
